items.title: ContextWeaver: Selective and Dependency-Structured Memory Construction for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: ContextWeaver：为 LLM Agent 构建选择性依赖结构化记忆
items.summary: ContextWeaver organizes an agent's interaction trace into a graph of reasoning steps, links each step to the earlier steps it depends on and selects relevant context for future actions. On five software-engineering and terminal benchmarks it improves resolve rates over a sliding-window baseline with 13-18% fewer agent steps, raising SWE-Bench Pro from 66.5% to 72.6%.

items.title: Thinking Without Words: Efficient Latent Reasoning with Abstract Chain-of-Thought
items.title_zh: 无词思考：基于抽象思维链的高效潜在推理
items.summary: Abstract Chain-of-Thought is a post-training mechanism in which a model emits a short sequence of reserved-vocabulary tokens instead of a natural-language chain of thought, trained with a warm-up loop of bottlenecked supervised fine-tuning and self-distillation followed by constrained-decoding reinforcement learning. It achieves up to 11.6x fewer reasoning tokens with comparable performance on mathematical, instruction-following and multi-hop reasoning tasks, and exhibits an emergent power-law distribution over the abstract vocabulary.

items.title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
items.title_zh: 智能体世界建模：基础、能力、规律与未来
items.summary: The paper proposes a levels-by-laws taxonomy for agentic world models, with three capability levels, Predictor, Simulator and Evolver, and four governing-law regimes covering physical, digital, social and scientific environments. It synthesizes over 400 works and more than 100 representative systems, analyzes failure modes and evaluation practice, and proposes decision-centric evaluation principles plus a minimal reproducible evaluation package.

items.title: Aligning Dense Retrievers with LLM Utility via Distillation
items.title_zh: 通过蒸馏使稠密检索器与 LLM 效用对齐
items.summary: Utility-Aligned Embeddings trains a bi-encoder to imitate a utility distribution derived from perplexity reduction using a Utility-Modulated InfoNCE objective, injecting graded utility signals into the embedding space without test-time LLM inference. On QASPER it improves Recall@1 by 30.59%, MAP by 30.16% and Token F1 by 17.3% over BGE-Base while running over 180x faster than efficient LLM re-ranking methods.

items.title: FormalScience: Scalable Human-in-the-Loop Autoformalisation of Science with Agentic Code Generation in Lean
items.title_zh: FormalScience：通过 Lean 中的智能体代码生成实现可扩展的人在环科学形式化
items.summary: FormalScience is a domain-agnostic, human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline that helps a single domain expert produce syntactically correct and semantically aligned Lean4 formalizations at low cost. Applied to physics, it yields FormalPhysics, 200 university-level problems with Lean4 representations, and characterizes semantic drift phenomena such as notational collapse and abstraction elevation.

items.title: Scaling Point-in-Time Language Models: Enabling Economic Evaluation of Embeddings
items.title_zh: 扩展时点语言模型：实现嵌入的经济评估
items.summary: The authors train decoder-only transformers up to 4B parameters on 1 trillion chronologically filtered FineWeb tokens to produce monthly checkpoints from 2013 to 2024, eliminating lookahead bias by construction. The models approach similarly sized open-weight models such as Gemma-3-4B and LLaMA-7B on common-sense and language-understanding benchmarks, though a gap remains on several tasks, and the full pipeline is released.

items.title: Don't Make the LLM Read the Graph: Make the Graph Think
items.title_zh: 别让 LLM 读图，让图去思考
items.summary: A study runs more than 3,000 controlled trials across four LLM families in the cooperative card game Hanabi to test whether explicit belief graphs improve multi-agent reasoning. It finds that graphs help mainly when they gate action selection rather than serve as prompt context, identifies a model-specific failure called Planner Defiance, and reports that inter-agent conventions outperform single-agent interventions.

items.title: A Systematic Approach for Large Language Models Debugging
items.title_zh: 大语言模型调试的系统化方法
items.summary: The paper proposes a model-agnostic methodology that treats LLMs as observable systems, unifying evaluation, interpretability and error analysis from issue detection through model refinement. It is designed to work where standardized benchmarks and evaluation criteria are lacking, and argues that the structure improves reproducibility, transparency and scalability of LLM deployments.
